'''Magistrate Rutherford Burnside'''<ref>[[Hillsbrad Town Registry]]</ref> is a [[human]] found in [[Hillsbrad Fields|Hillsbrad]] in the [[Hillsbrad Foothills]]. He is the current leader of the [[Hillsbrad Fields]].

[[High Executor Darthalia]] wants Burnside killed in order to disrupt the leadership of the Hillsbrad community.

==Abilities==
* '''Inferno Shell''' — Inflicts Fire damage to nearby enemies.
* '''Fireball''' — Inflicts Fire damage to an enemy.
* '''Fire Nova''' — Inflicts 147 to 177 Fire damage to nearby enemies, and encases the caster in a shield of flame that lasts 10 sec. and burns melee attackers for an additional 50 damage.

==Objective of==
* {{Horde}} [26] [[Battle of Hillsbrad (4)]]

==Speculation==
He may be related to the bankers in [[Stormwind City]] - [[Olivia Burnside]], [[Newton Burnside]], [[John Burnside]].
